text: Festival demand shows clearly on Amazon today: LED string lights and candles fill the Home & Kitchen top ranks, and gold coins rank high in Jewellery just before Dhanteras. For a beginner, low-priced everyday items in Sports & Fitness and Toys look most approachable, while Electronics and Beauty are led by big brands.

headline: Clothing & Accessories: kurta sets lead, brands are strong
text: Women's kurta sets hold the top two ranks, followed by big names like Allen Solly and Jockey. The typical price is about ₹514, well above what we see on Meesho's top listings. A saree shapewear petticoat at ₹225 shows there's room for simple, useful items. Sizes mean returns, and well-known brands are hard to compete with, so this is a difficult place to start.

headline: Shoes & Handbags: comfort slippers top the list
text: Comfort and orthopedic slippers hold the top two ranks with relatively few reviews, which suggests recent demand. Established names like Campus, Sparx and Asian follow. The typical price is about ₹599. Footwear comes in sizes, which usually means more returns, so non-sized items in this department are the safer place to look.

headline: Bags & Luggage: big trolley sets dominate
text: Trolley sets from Safari and Aristocrat fill the top ranks, likely helped by festive travel. These are bulky, branded and priced in the thousands, so they need more money and are costly to ship. The typical price across the list is about ₹739. A beginner should look further down the list for smaller bags rather than competing with these.

headline: Home & Kitchen: Diwali lights are everywhere
text: LED string lights and rope lights take many of the top ranks, some under ₹100, alongside tealight candles just days before Diwali. Amazon's own brands also rank high here, in candles and garbage bags. The average rating is the lowest of any department at about 3.85, which hints at quality complaints on cheap lights. It's too late to start Diwali stock now, but small, light home items suit beginners. The typical price is about ₹295.

headline: Beauty: soaps and face wash from known brands
text: Dettol, Ghar Soaps, Cetaphil and Simple lead with low everyday prices, and the typical price is about ₹249. Ratings are high overall. A small parfum and a Ghar Soaps combo rank high with under 100 reviews, which suggests recent interest. Reselling brands needs authorisation and making your own cosmetics needs a licence, so this is hard for a beginner.

headline: Jewellery: gold coins surge before Dhanteras
text: Gold coins and pendants costing ₹15,000 or more rank near the top with few reviews, a clear sign of Dhanteras buying. That's a short seasonal spike and not something a beginner should stock. Further down, fashion jewellery like earring sets and bangles is much cheaper, and the typical price across the list is about ₹280. Those items are light with no sizes, and wedding season is ahead.

headline: Electronics: new phones lead, not a beginner's game
text: New OnePlus and iQOO phones hold many top ranks, with prices of ₹17,000 and above, some with few reviews, likely because they've just launched. OnePlus earbuds and a Samsung charger show that accessories sell too. The typical price is about ₹799. Phones are out of reach for a new seller, and branded accessories are hard to beat, so only simple unbranded accessories are worth checking.

headline: Health & Personal Care: household basics from big brands
text: This list is mostly household staples such as tissues, detergent, handwash and fabric conditioner from Godrej, Surf Excel, Dettol and Comfort. Amazon's own Presto brand also appears. Prices are low, with a typical price of about ₹199, and ratings are the highest of any department. These are repeat purchases with strong brands and thin margins, so there's little room for a beginner.

headline: Toys & Games: writing pads and soft toys sell well
text: LCD writing pads, soft toys and die-cast cars rank high, along with a kids' scooter and tricycle. The typical price is about ₹289. A remote control car ranks in the top 10 with under 100 reviews, which suggests fresh demand. Small toys have no sizes and are easy to ship, though toys sold in India have safety rules to check first, so read up on those before you stock anything.

headline: Sports & Fitness: simple home workout gear leads
text: Pull-up bars, dumbbells, resistance bands and protein shakers lead, mainly from fitness-focused brands like Lifelong and Boldfit. The typical price is about ₹431, and a resistance band at ₹149 and a shaker at ₹89 show that small items sell well. Those are light and have no sizes, so they suit a beginner much better than heavy dumbbells or treadmills.

Resistance bands and other small fitness accessories.
Protein shakers and light workout gear.
LCD writing pads and small soft toys, after checking toy safety rules.
Fashion earring and bangle sets, ahead of wedding season.
Small, light home items, once Diwali has passed.
Avoid for now: phones, gold jewellery, big trolley sets, branded beauty and household staples, and Diwali-only stock, which is too late to start.
